name: Golden Bell Farm formerly Cedar Brae Berry Farm
tagline: Golden Bell Farm (formerly 'Cedar Brae Berry Farm')
description: In Franklin, TN, Golden Bell Farm formerly Cedar Brae Berry Farm raises Blueberries on a working farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
